facts: Official Branding with Type page identifies Bw Seido Collection and explicitly lists Bw Seido Raw and Bw Seido Round as its two subfamilies.
The collection page records 24 styles total: six weights plus matching oblique italics across the two subfamilies.
The collection page states Extended Latin language support.

Bw Seido.note: The recovered umbrella name Bw Seido is retained as a stable catalog identity for the official collection. ONOD must not silently render either Raw or Round when the recovered record asks for Bw Seido.

facts: Official Google Fonts METADATA.pb identifies the current family as Cedarville Cursive, designed by Kimberly Geswein, licensed OFL, with one normal 400 face.
The recovered ONOD catalog spelling Cederville Cursive differs from the canonical Google family only by the incorrect vowel in Cedarville.

Cederville Cursive.note: This is a reviewed catalog spelling correction, not a historical successor or similarity match. The recovered stable font ID may render the canonical Cedarville Cursive family.

facts: The official google/fonts removal commit deletes Open Sans Condensed from the catalog and shows the prior METADATA.pb with exact family identity Open Sans Condensed, designer Steve Matteson and license APACHE2.
The prior METADATA.pb records normal 300, italic 300 and normal 700 faces and Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese subsets.
The historical LICENSE.txt blob is Apache License 2.0.

Open Sans Condensed.note: Open Sans Condensed is a verified historical Google Fonts family removed from the catalog on 2024-09-24. ONOD may preserve its historical identity and technical metadata but must not silently substitute another Open Sans family for rendering.

facts: Official Adobe repository history contains SourceSansPro release files and package identity for Source Sans Pro.
LICENSE.txt at the historical Source Sans Pro revision explicitly licenses the Font Software under SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The same official Adobe repository later releases Source Sans 3 version 3.052 and SourceSans3 font files.

Source Sans Pro.note: This relation proves historical identity and successor lineage. It does not authorize ONOD to silently render Source Sans 3 when the catalog record asks for Source Sans Pro.
